# A distant iceberg, 2.4 m wide, 1.3 m tall: a faceted peak and a lower shoulder. Generated by make_env.py.
new
material new Snow --base-color 0.769 0.941 0.761 --no-slot
material new Ice --base-color 0.353 0.725 0.659 --no-slot
add mesh cone --name Peak --vertices 5 --radius1 0.9 --radius2 0.12 --depth 1.4 --location -0.3 0 0.6
material assign Ice
add mesh cone --name Shoulder --vertices 5 --radius1 0.8 --radius2 0.25 --depth 0.8 --location 0.55 0.1 0.3
material assign Ice
select Peak Shoulder
active Peak
join
rename Peak Berg
active Berg
mode edit
select vert where "pos.z > 0.05"
randomize --amount 0.08 --seed 21
select face where "normal.z > 0.55"
material assign Snow
select face where "normal.z < -0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object
shade flat
export berg.glb
